# Pizzeria Roma

> Wood-fired pizza restaurant in Sudbury, Ontario, Canada. Every pizza is cooked in a genuine wood oven — no gas, no shortcuts.

## Business Overview

- Name: Pizzeria Roma
- Type: Restaurant / Pizzeria (wood-fired)
- Cuisine: Italian, Pizza

- Price range: $$

Note: the number "1894" that appears in the Pizzeria Roma logo refers to a former street address (1894 LaSalle Blvd), not a founding year. Pizzeria Roma does not claim historical founding dates.

## What Makes Pizzeria Roma Different

Every pizza at Pizzeria Roma is cooked in a genuine wood-fired oven, not a gas or electric one. The higher, more intense heat of real wood fire cooks the dough in roughly 90 seconds to two minutes — far faster than a standard oven — producing a crust that's crisp and lightly charred on the outside while staying light and airy inside. The wood itself adds a faint smokiness no gas or electric oven can replicate.

## Menu

The menu includes wood-fired pizzas (Margherita, Prosciutto e Funghi, Diavola, Quattro Formaggi, and more), house-made pasta (Tagliatelle al Ragù, Penne alla Vodka), appetizers (Bruschetta, Arancini), salads, and desserts (Tiramisu). Vegetarian options are available. Full menu: https://pizzeriaroma.ca/en/menu

## Delivery

Pizzeria Roma delivers across Sudbury, Ontario through Uber Eats, Skip The Dishes, and DoorDash. Pickup orders can be placed by calling the restaurant directly at 705-222-7662.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What makes Pizzeria Roma's pizza different?
Every pizza is cooked in a genuine wood-fired oven, not a gas or electric one. The higher, more intense heat of real wood fire cooks the dough faster, which keeps it airy inside while giving the crust a light char you can't get any other way.

### Does Pizzeria Roma deliver in Sudbury?
Yes. Pizzeria Roma delivers across Sudbury, Ontario through Uber Eats, Skip The Dishes and DoorDash. You can also call the restaurant directly to place an order for pickup.

### What are Pizzeria Roma's hours?
Pizzeria Roma is open Monday to Thursday 11:00 am–9:00 pm, Friday and Saturday 11:00 am–10:00 pm, and Sunday 12:00 pm–9:00 pm.

### Where is Pizzeria Roma located?
Pizzeria Roma is located in Sudbury, Ontario. Call 705-222-7662 or visit the Contact page for directions.

### Does Pizzeria Roma offer vegetarian options?
Yes — the menu includes vegetarian pizzas such as the Margherita and Quattro Formaggi, plus pasta, salads and appetizers that can be made meat-free.
